meetings.title: 4th Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: In today’s meeting, Committee discussed the Tobacco Control Act (Law No. 15/2010) Amendment Bill. The changes proposed by the Attorney General’s Office were shared with the Committee. As no member raised any objection to the bill following the incorporation of the changes proposed by the Attorney General's Office, the Committee Chairperson put the matter to a vote. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present.

meetings.title: 3rd Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: In today’s meeting, the Committee discussed the Tobacco Control Act (Law No. 15/2010) Amendment Bill. The following amendments were brought to the bill today. 1. Funadhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Mamdhooh proposed to amend Section 6 of the Act. The proposal was seconded by Kudahuvadhoo Constituency Member Hussain Hameed. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. 2. Kudahuvadhoo Constituency Member Hussain Hameed proposed to amend Section 10 of the Act. The proposal was seconded by Velidhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Abbas. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. 3. Funadhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Mamdhooh proposed to amend Section 10-3 (b) which is being added to the Act. The proposal was seconded by Kudahuvadhoo Constituency Member Hussain Hameed. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. 4. Funadhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Mamdhooh proposed to amend Section 29 (d) (3) of the Act. The proposal was seconded by Kudahuvadhoo Constituency Member Hussain Hameed. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. 5. Funadhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Mamdhooh proposed to amend Section 29 (d) (3) of the Act. The proposal was seconded by Kudahuvadhoo Constituency Member Hussain Hameed. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. 6. Funadhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Mamdhooh proposed to amend Section 42 of the Act. The proposal was seconded by Kudahuvadhoo Constituency Member Hussain Hameed. The proposal was passed unanimously by the members present. As there was no objection from the committee members, the Chairperson proposed to pass the remaining sections of the bill without any amendments. This proposal was passed unanimously by the members present.

meetings.title: 2nd Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: Firstly, the committee met with relevant officials from the Maldives Customs Service to discuss the Tobacco Control Act (Law No. 15/2010) Amendment Bill. In this regard, the officials shared their views on the specific provisions of the Bill and addressed any questions raised by the committee members. Additionally, they highlighted potential challenges they anticipate facing, once the Bill is enacted. Next, the committee members reviewed the bill in detail, reading and discussing each section individually.

meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: The first item on today's Agenda was to appoint the Chairperson and Deputy Chairperson of the Committee. Director, Legal Affairs, Aishath Shifa conducted the appointment process of the Chairperson and Deputy Chairperson of the Committee. Kaashidhoo Constituency Member Munthazim Ibrahim proposed to elect West Maafannu Constituency Member Mohamed Musthafa Ibrahim as the Chairperson of the Committee. This proposal was seconded by South Fuvahmulah Constituency Member Ibrahim Hussain. The proposal was unanimously passed. The details of this vote is in the “Votes” part of this page. Secondly, Member for South Fuvahmulah Constituency Ibrahim Hussain proposed to elect Funadhoo Constituency member Mohamed Mamdhooh as the Deputy Chairperson of the Committee. This proposal was seconded by Kudahuvadhoo Constituency Member Hussain Hameed. The proposal was unanimously passed. The details of this vote is in the “Votes” part of this page. The Second item on today's Agenda was to set a deadline for the completion of the bill (Amendment to the Tobacco Act (Act No. 15/2010)). Member for North Galolhu Constituency Mohamed Ibrahim proposed, and Kudahuvadhoo Constituency Member Hussain Hameed seconded that the deadline for the completion of the bill be set for 12 th May 2025. The proposal was unanimously passed. The details of this vote is in the “Votes” part of this page. Furthermore, the committee discussed the process for proceeding with the bill, and decided to open for public comments, as well as request relevant stakeholders to share their comments regarding the bill in writing. The stakeholders include Maldives Customs Service, Ministry of Health, Health Protection Agency, and Maldives Police Service.
